marker_last: Slovene "last/previous" determiner, the full adjectival paradigm.  Slovene
agrees the determiner with the unit's gender, and the three temporal units
span all three genders -- masculine "teden", masculine "mesec", neuter "leto"
-- so the neuter "prejšnje leto" needs the neuter form the nominative-only
listing lacked.  Fran (ZRC SAZU), SSKJ2 / Slovenski pravopis: prejšnji -a -e.
marker_next: Slovene "next/following" determiner, the full adjectival paradigm for both the
"naslednji" and the "prihodnji" stems; the neuter "naslednje leto" is the
ordinary "next year".  Fran (ZRC SAZU), SSKJ2: naslednji -a -e.
marker_ordlast: Slovene "last" ordinal determiner, the soft adjective "zadnji" in concord
with the scoped weekday.  "zadnji petek v novembru" = last Friday of November.
Soft adjectival paradigm zadnji -a -e (Fran / SSKJ2, ZRC SAZU).

unit1_second: Slovene "sekunda" singular surfaces: nominative and accusative.
unit_month: Slovene "mesec", full paradigm.  Fran (ZRC SAZU), SSKJ2.
unit_second: Slovene "sekunda", matching the depth of unit_minute.voc: nominative
singular after 1, the DUAL after 2, the plural after 3-4, the genitive
plural after 5+, and the accusative "cez sekundo".
unit_week: Slovene "teden", fleeting-vowel stem (teden / tedna).  Full paradigm; the dual
nominative is syncretic with the genitive singular "tedna".
unit_year: Slovene "leto", neuter, full paradigm.  The locative "letu" and the dative
"letu" carry "v prejšnjem letu".  Fran (ZRC SAZU), SSKJ2.
